notes: Edit every REPLACE_ field above before the first run. The search agent reads this file to decide what counts as a relevant grant. home_base is where the org is registered/headquartered (used for HQ-only local grants); service_areas lists everywhere it actually operates or serves clients (used for state/regional grants, which usually require operating in-state, not just federal registration there). If home_base and service_areas are the same place, list it in both.
